BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4044.name: Eternal Bonds Bashin Dan
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4044.effect:
[Core Charge: (Superstar/Galaxian & Cost 3 or more) (Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2]
Add to your Hand a "Superstar"/"Galaxian" family card sent to the Trash by this Nexus' [Core Charge].

[Grand Field] [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
(Once per turn: Same Name) When your originally Cost 6 or more "Superstar"/"Galaxian" family Spirit destroys any opposing Spirit, by sending three cores from this Nexus to the Void, send an opposing Life to the Void.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
This Nexus' God symbol is also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4045.name: Eternal Bonds Shinomiya Mai
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4045.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Superstar/Galaxian & Cost 3 or more) (Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

This card is also treated as being exactly-named "Viole Mai".

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Draw a card, and send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
This Nexus' God symbol is also treated as Red/Purple. Also, while you control exactly-named "Eternal Bonds Bashin Dan" and "Eternal Bonds Shinomiya Mai", one of each, those Nexuses can't be destroyed.
